{{- /* A guide's code spans that name an API symbol, linked to its reference page, for the guide's Markdown version: the counterpart of the links guide-body.html adds to the HTML page, through the same lookup (api-name-url.html). page-markdown.html then points the link to the symbol's index.md. Only a span that is a whole name or an array of it (`IMeasure`, `IMeasure[]`) links: Markdown cannot put a link inside a code span, so a union (`IBucket | undefined`) stays plain rather than sending `undefined` to the IBucket page. Lowercase names never link (`measures`, `onError` collide with symbol names). Left as written: code inside fences, a span that already is a link's text (the generated Props tables), headings, and lines with a double-backtick span. Expects: dict "page" (the guide) "text" (its Markdown). Returns the Markdown with the links. */ -}} {{- $page := .page -}} {{- $inFence := false -}} {{- $closer := "" -}} {{- $lines := slice -}} {{- range split .text "\n" -}} {{- $line := . -}} {{- with findRESubmatch "^[ \t]*(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$" $line 1 -}} {{- $marker := index (index . 0) 1 -}} {{- if $inFence -}} {{- if and (eq (substr $marker 0 1) (substr $closer 0 1)) (ge (len $marker) (len $closer)) (eq (trim (index (index . 0) 2) " \t\r") "") -}} {{- $inFence = false -}} {{- end -}} {{- else -}} {{- $inFence = true -}} {{- $closer = $marker -}} {{- end -}} {{- else -}} {{- $parts := split $line "`" -}} {{- if and (not $inFence) (gt (len $parts) 2) (modBool (len $parts) 2 | not) (not (strings.Contains $line "``")) (not (hasPrefix (trim $line " ") "#")) -}} {{- $out := slice -}} {{- range $i, $part := $parts -}} {{- if modBool $i 2 -}} {{- $out = $out | append $part -}} {{- else -}} {{- $code := printf "`%s`" $part -}} {{- $isLinkText := and (hasSuffix (index $parts (sub $i 1)) "[") (hasPrefix (index $parts (add $i 1)) "]") -}} {{- if and (findRE `^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\[\])?$` $part) (not $isLinkText) -}} {{- with partial "api-name-url.html" (dict "page" $page "name" (strings.TrimSuffix "[]" $part)) -}} {{- $code = printf "[%s](%s)" $code . -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $out = $out | append $code -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $line = delimit $out "" -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $lines = $lines | append $line -}} {{- end -}} {{- return delimit $lines "\n" -}}
